properties.name: Jørgenhuken
properties.description:
Lean-to that gives a basic protector  from weather. A long bench to sit on and two small tables. Fence to keep off the sheep.
Named in memory of Jørgen Letrud the friendly face of this area for many years that passed away in 2015 (aged 83).
